warrants.quote: At June 30, 2024, the Company had outstanding Common Warrants to purchase 2,536,391 Common Shares, with an exercise price of $3.003, all of which were classified as derivative warrant liability.
At June 30, 2024, the Company had outstanding Pre-funded Warrants to purchase 1,366,419 Common Shares, with an exercise price of $0.0001, all of which were classified within shareholders' equity.
